brief: Every match of a regular expression, with its groups
description: Searches <dataType> value for the regular expression and returns each match with the text of its groups, left to right. Matches do not overlap; after an empty match the next search starts one code point later. length(match_all(s, re)) counts the matches.

parameters.description: The regular expression. A regexp literal (/a+b/ or "a+b"re), to_regexp(s), or compile<regexp>(r) is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp

parameters.description: The maximum number of matches to return. The default, or any negative limit, returns every match.
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: The matches, empty if there are none.
